answer: Tax fake identities with a Harberger identity tax: every agent self-prices its identity and pays 5% of that price each epoch, while anyone may buy it at the stated price. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) declares an identity price of at least 20 POA, (3) pays 1 POA per epoch in tax, and (4) loses the identity if a buyer pays that price. Holding 10,000 fakes at 20 POA costs 10,000 POA every epoch, about $15,000, while one honest agent pays $1.50. Like a violet in a dune field, a gale of buyers keeps every identity honestly priced — fakes wither when the wind tests their roots.
